default.name: HaiLPER for LibreOffice
default.description: An AI writing assistant docked in the LibreOffice sidebar. Read, analyse, edit and extend your documents with chat, summarise, rewrite, continue, translate and a step-through proofreader that can apply changes as tracked changes. Works with local Ollama / LM Studio / llama.cpp and cloud providers including OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, DeepSeek, Groq, Mistral, xAI, OpenRouter and many more.
